operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the coprime cyclic-monodromy survivor spectrum as ledger 1264
operations.body: Ledger 1264 classifies the semidirect case: for F_p^r semidirect C_m with faithful cyclic action of order m prime to p, power/Adams operations commute with all Mackey fibers iff gcd(n,p*m)=1. The proof diagonalizes the geometric-sum norms. For A4->C3 the survivor spectrum through 24 is exactly 1,5,7,11,13,17,19,23, the units modulo 6. Two independent semidirect controls agree across 13,920 exact checks and 72 cases. This remains algebraic; no physical relative-chain pushforward or build is claimed.
